title: Calibration
description: Adjust the display scale so that on-screen measurements match real-world physical dimensions.

instructions.title: How to calibrate
instructions.step1: Place a standard card (85.60 mm × 53.98 mm) against your screen.
instructions.step2: Use the slider to adjust the on-screen card width until it matches the physical card exactly.
instructions.step3: Click “Calibrate” to save the scale factor.
instructions.step4: Double-click the slider to reset the calibration to its default value.
